name: ascendia
description: Plateforme de gestion de réseaux sociaux assistée par IA (microservices Node.js + React).

scripts.install:all: npm install && for d in backend/gateway backend/services/users backend/services/socialAuth backend/services/posts frontend/reactJS; do (cd $d && npm install); done
scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,users,socialauth,posts,front -c gray,blue,magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend/gateway" "npm run dev --prefix backend/services/users" "npm run dev --prefix backend/services/socialAuth" "npm run dev --prefix backend/services/posts" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/reactJS"
